newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rolls back oil product price increases.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rolls back oil product price increases.

text.p: The Nepali government on Tuesday rolled back prices of diesel by 11.4 percent and kerosene by 4.5 percent following pressure from transporters and political parties, the state radio said on Tuesday.

"His majesty's government has instructed Nepal Oil Corporation to make some reductions in the recently increased prices of products like kerosene, diesel, and cooking gas," state Radio said on Tuesday.
